deadline: minimum of fixed recheck interval, remaining phase budget, and any existing earlier terminal grace deadline; retries never refresh it
diagnostics: fresh per-attempt field outcomes and kernel context; executable and argv fingerprints rather than raw values; diagnostic sink errors fail closed
immediate_refusals: nonempty identity mismatch, foreign owner/birth, permission error, exhausted deadline, or diagnostic failure
live_metadata: fresh process wrapper per observation; exact nonempty executable and argv with kernel checks before and after
name: bounded-retained-original-owner-recheck-v1
namespace_gate: validates exact proof-object identity and original Popen object, then invokes fresh independent original-exit check
positive_exit: matching poll and zero-time original Popen wait plus strict numeric absence; raises proof-bearing Vanished, never returns a cached live row
same_birth_zombie: inherits existing zombie handling; not a new positive-wait claim
scope: already authenticated retained original Popen owners only
transient_only: empty metadata or exact-owner disappearance may be re-observed within the same bound
unchanged: original deadlines, cleanup authority, ownership locks, resource ceilings, observation accounting, source pins, and no-retry-POST boundary
